Baron Emerging Markets Fund underperformed with a return of 19.61% (Institutional Shares) during Q2 2026 as compared to its benchmark, the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, which returned 24.05%.
The Fund initiated new positions in Divi's Laboratories, Acutaas Chemicals, Rasan Information Technology, and OTP Bank Nyrt.
During the quarter, the fund exited several positions, including InPost S.A.
, HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering, Kuaishou Technology
, Park Systems, Kaynes Technology India, WuXi Biologics (Cayman)

The fund remains constructive on EM equities but expects near-term volatility from elevated AI valuations, heavy AI-related capital spending, and geopolitical risks, while seeing opportunities in oversold digitization, fintech, software, and Indian growth stocks.

title: Baron Emerging Markets Fund repositions portfolio with 4 new positions and7 exits
